name: Timur's Invasion, Battle of Ankara
summary: Timur (Tamerlane) invades Anatolia and defeats the Ottoman army at the Battle of Ankara (July 1402). Sultan Bayezid I is captured, the first Ottoman sultan taken prisoner in battle, and dies in Timurid captivity. Timur dismembers the Ottoman Empire, restoring Anatolian beyliks and returning Anatolia to its pre-Ottoman fragmentation. An Ottoman interregnum (1402-1413) follows as Bayezid's sons fight over the throne.

_quarry.structural_significance: Timur's victory saves Constantinople, the city had been under Ottoman siege since 1394; the Byzantines gain 50 more years of existence (until 1453); the Ottoman interregnum demonstrates the empire's vulnerability to succession crises but also its institutional resilience, the Ottoman state reconstitutes itself completely under Mehmed I (1413-1421); Ankara is a reminder that the Ottoman Empire could have been destroyed in 1402
